question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

Something that is necessary or crucial
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3' **i.e. **'Indispensable'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given group of words **"Something that is necessary or crucial" **refers to something that is of utmost importance or vital.(कुछ जो आवश्यक या महत्वपूर्ण है).
 
• The correct word **"Indispensable" **means something absolutely necessary or essential.(अनिवार्य).

Therefore, the** correct answer** is- **'Indispensable'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Pedantic'** means overly concerned with minute details or formalisms, especially in teaching.(पढ़ाकू).
 
• ** 'Trivial' **means of little value or importance.(तुच्छ).
 
• **'Auxiliary' **means providing supplementary or additional help and support.(सहायक).
